title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 10B: Languages and numbers
subtitle: Languages, superlatives and high numbers

words.def: the words that people in a country use to speak and write
words.sent: Italian is a beautiful ___.

words.def: very nice to look at or to hear
words.sent: I think Italian is the most ___ language in the world.

words.def: with a nice sound, like music
words.sent: Italian is a very ___ language.

words.def: not easy; hard to do or understand
words.sent: Japanese is very ___ for English speakers.

words.def: not difficult; you can do it without problems
words.sent: I think Spanish is the ___ language to learn.

words.def: good for doing something; helping you
words.sent: A dictionary is very ___ when you study English.

words.def: liked by many people
words.sent: Mandarin is the most ___ language in the world.

words.def: the number of people who live in a place
words.sent: China has the biggest ___ in the world.

words.def: the way you write the letters of a word
words.sent: I always check my ___ in a dictionary.

words.def: all the letters of a language
words.sent: Khmer has the longest ___ — it has 74 letters.

words.def: a book or website that explains what words mean
words.sent: I use an online ___ to look up new words.

words.def: a website where a person writes about their life or interests
words.sent: She reads a ___ about languages every day.

words.def: something that is true
words.sent: Here is an interesting ___ about languages.

words.def: first from a place; the people who lived there first
words.sent: Quechua is an ___ language of South America.

words.def: the number 1,000,000
words.sent: About nine hundred ___ people speak Mandarin.

words.def: the number 1,000
words.sent: The dictionary has six hundred ___ words.

words.def: the number 100
words.sent: One ___ and twenty is 120.

words.def: moving or doing something quickly
words.sent: Fran Capo is the ___est talker in the world.

words.def: weighing a lot
words.sent: The dictionary is very ___ — it weighs 62 kilograms.

words.def: the most bad
words.sent: This is the ___ film I have ever seen.
